launch_slurm_job: launch a slurm sbatch job from a script string and return the job id
run_training_job: run a distributed LLM training job on SLURM with nanotron config and dataset
create_config_yaml: create a nanotron training config YAML from dataclass args and save it
check_checkpoint_resume: check if a training run already reached the target checkpoint step
download_s3_dataset: download a dataset from S3 to local scratch before training
